title: Intersection theory on singular moduli spaces of vector bundles: a parabolic approach
summary: We present explicit formulas for the intersection pairing in the intersection cohomology of the moduli space $M_0(r)$ of rank-$r$, degree-$0$ semistable bundles on a Riemann surface. The key idea is to realize this intersection cohomology as a canonical subspace of the cohomology of a smooth moduli space of parabolic bundles, where the pairing can be computed via the Hecke correspondence and the Jeffrey-Kirwan iterated residue formulas.
